ideas.title: The Room Becomes the Container
ideas.normalExpectation: A lid covers a container opening without expanding.
ideas.impossibleRule: The lid grows one size step whenever pressure is applied to it.
ideas.visibleTrigger: Normal use activates the stated rule.
ideas.whyThisObject: Growth destroys the fit required for a lid to close.
ideas.goalRuleRelationship: The object function produces a visible obstacle to the everyday goal.
ideas.frameZeroDescription: Kiko is already trying to close the lid; she pushes the lid toward its rim. The lid grows another size step and blocks the opening; her eyes widen.

beats.strategy: pushes the lid toward the container rim
beats.visibleConsequence: The lid grows one size step and pushes the rim out of reach.
beats.newInformation: Normal closing pressure enlarges the obstruction.

beats.strategy: turns the lid sideways and grabs its opposite edge
beats.visibleConsequence: The lid grows larger than before and blocks the route around the container.
beats.newInformation: Changing the approach cannot preserve usable clearance.

beats.strategy: guides the lid along the table and wedges its edge
beats.visibleConsequence: The lid grows larger than before and squeezes the usable space beside the wall.
beats.newInformation: The attempted surface guide becomes a room constraint.

beats.strategy: lifts the last reachable edge toward the opening
beats.visibleConsequence: The enormous lid grows until it fills the room; Kiko is crouched beneath it while the container remains open behind her.
beats.newInformation: The room becomes the space controlled by the same growing lid.

ideas.finalPayoff: The enormous lid grows until it fills the room; Kiko is crouched beneath it while the container remains open behind her.
ideas.environment: Simple indoor working space with fixed table and wall.
ideas.providerRationale: A fixture proposal for deterministic review, not a winner or score.

ideas.title: A Dry Table Wearing Its Spill
ideas.everydayGoal: dry the table without soaking clothes
ideas.normalExpectation: A towel absorbs water and leaves the wiped surface drier.
ideas.impossibleRule: Every wipe removes water from the table but transfers the exact wet patch onto the character clothes.
ideas.visibleTrigger: Normal use activates the stated rule.
ideas.whyThisObject: Only a water-removing cloth connects wiping to transferred wet patches.
ideas.goalRuleRelationship: The object function produces a visible obstacle to the everyday goal.
ideas.frameZeroDescription: Kiko tries to dry the table with a towel. A wipe removes a wet mark from the table; that wet mark appears on her sleeve while the towel is held against the spill.

beats.strategy: wipes the small spill with the towel
beats.visibleConsequence: A wet patch disappears from the table and appears on Kiko sleeve.
beats.newInformation: The water has moved to clothing instead of remaining in the towel.

beats.strategy: folds the towel to use a dry corner
beats.visibleConsequence: The next wet stripe disappears from the table and appears across the shirt.
beats.newInformation: A dry corner still transfers the same water pattern.

beats.strategy: guides the towel along the far table edge
beats.visibleConsequence: The final wet rectangle disappears and leaves matching patches across the sleeves and shirt.
beats.newInformation: Every removed shape is preserved on clothing.

beats.strategy: turns the towel to wipe the last circle
beats.visibleConsequence: The table is finally dry; Kiko clothes display the exact complete pattern of the former spill.
beats.newInformation: The everyday goal is achieved at the cost of wearing the water.

ideas.finalPayoff: The table is finally dry; Kiko clothes display the exact complete pattern of the former spill.
ideas.environment: Simple indoor working space with fixed table and wall.
ideas.providerRationale: A fixture proposal for deterministic review, not a winner or score.
